fields.description: What this slot is, in plain words: "Hero headline", "Second photo band, caption". Shown beside the pencil when the page is edited.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The stable key the page asks for. Renaming the label never blanks a page. Keys read as a path, such as landing.hero.headline.
fields.label: Content Key

fields.description: Which screen this block belongs to. The surface decides whether signed-out visitors can see it.
fields.label: Surface

fields.description: Ordering for this list only, so the blocks read top to bottom the way the page does. It moves nothing on the page itself.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: The words shown in this slot. Plain text; line breaks are kept.
fields.label: Text

fields.description: Where this slot links to, if anywhere. A path within the site, or an http, https, mailto or tel address.
fields.label: Link

fields.description: The picture shown in this slot. Left empty, the page draws its own placeholder rather than a broken image.
fields.label: Image

fields.description: What the picture shows, for screen readers and for when the image does not load. A decorative photo may leave it empty.
fields.label: Alt Text

fields.description: Who took the picture and under what licence, shown as a small caption over it. Empty means no caption.
fields.label: Photo Credit

fields.description: Guidance for whoever edits this next: how long the text should be, what the picture needs to show. Never shown to a visitor.
fields.label: Editor Notes
